notes: Trust release — verified by an automated in-app self-test, not claims: the control pill now provably sits ABOVE the camera bubble (runtime-verified window levels), so controls can no longer vanish behind your face while recording. New flight-recorder logging: every button press, menu pick, window show/hide with coordinates, a heartbeat every 30 s proving bytes are being written mid-recording, and session start/end markers. Built-in self-test mode (--selftest) that arms, records, stops, and validates the saved file end to end. Recordings save to Downloads. Clear guidance when macOS revokes the Screen Recording permission after an update.
